notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
1.3
[list]
[*] Fixed low jumping height glitch (This was an error caused by the game running at a lower frame-rate on some computers)
[*] Added key binding system in options (This will help people with non-QWERTY keyboards)
[*] Locked days look more locked (Thank you Peter Brinson!)
[*] Fixed audio bug
[*] Enhanced Realistic Mode
[/list]

Note: Temporarily removed Linux compatibility.
